<?php

use MockServer\MockServerClient;
use MockServer\Expectation;

$client = new MockServerClient('localhost', <port>);

$client->upsertExpectation(Expectation::fromArray(json_decode(<<<'JSON'
{
  "httpRequest" : {
    "method" : "GET",
    "path" : "/a\\b\"c\ndé中`JSON\"#x"
  },
  "httpResponse" : {
    "statusCode" : 200,
    "body" : {
      "type" : "STRING",
      "string" : "body\\with\"quote\nnewlineé中`\"\"\"triple\nJSON\n\"##end",
      "rawBytes" : "Ym9keVx3aXRoInF1b3RlCm5ld2xpbmXpP2AiIiJ0cmlwbGUKSlNPTgoiIyNlbmQ="
    }
  },
  "id" : "<uuid>",
  "priority" : 0,
  "timeToLive" : {
    "unlimited" : true
  },
  "times" : {
    "unlimited" : true
  }
}
JSON, true)));
